verdict.rationale: Bugbot lets teams write project-specific review guidelines in plain language via `.cursor/BUGBOT.md`, runs automatically on every PR update, and can be tuned with natural-language effort instructions — covering the core 'custom agentic checks in plain language, run on every PR' idea. However, it functions as a commenting/reviewer bot (inline suggestions, Fix-in-Cursor links) rather than a formal named-check/pass-fail gate system, so discrete named checks like 'docs updated' or 'tests cover new paths' as blocking merge gates aren't explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit support for defining multiple discrete named checks with pass/fail merge-gate status, independent evidence of BUGBOT.md guidelines being followed precisely as distinct checks.
